categories.main_business_segments: Grandit Co., Ltd. (Zhongjuxin) primarily operates in the semiconductor materials sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of electronic wet chemicals, electronic specialty gases, and precursor materials. These products are essential for manufacturing processes in integrated circuits, display panels, and photovoltaic industries. The company also engages in the development of functional chemical formulations and precursor materials to support advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in product preparation, quality inspection, and packaging for electronic chemical materials. It employs advanced purification, mixing, and formulation techniques to meet stringent purity and performance standards required by semiconductor manufacturing. Key production methods include atomic layer deposition (ALD) precursor synthesis, ultra-high purity gas production, and precision chemical formulation for etching and cleaning processes. Continuous R&D and process optimization underpin its technological edge.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhongjuxin serves major semiconductor manufacturers and related industries, including integrated circuit fabs, display panel producers, and photovoltaic cell manufacturers. Its customer base includes leading domestic and international semiconductor companies such as SMIC, Changjiang Storage, Huahong Group, SK Hynix, TSMC, UMC, Intel, and others. The company targets high-end semiconductor manufacturing processes, supplying critical materials for advanced logic and memory chip production.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with significant revenue generated from domestic customers accounting for over 90% of sales. It also maintains a presence in overseas markets, including Taiwan and South Korea, supplying electronic specialty gases and other products to key clients in these regions. The company is expanding its international footprint through strategic investments and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongjuxin operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the production of high-purity electronic chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials essential for semiconductor wafer fabrication. It supplies these critical raw materials directly to semiconductor manufacturers, positioning itself as a key materials provider supporting chip fabrication processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on enhancing product quality, expanding production capacity, and developing new functional chemical formulations and precursor materials. It invests heavily in R&D, with a dedicated engineering research center and multiple ongoing projects targeting advanced semiconductor process nodes and materials. Strategic priorities include domestic substitution of imported materials, expanding product portfolios, and digital transformation to improve operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Zhongjuxin generates revenue primarily through direct sales of electronic wet chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials to semiconductor manufacturers and related industries. The company employs a sales model centered on direct customer engagement, including both direct sales and agency sales, with some products sold via distributors. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically stipulating payment terms post-delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the leading domestic producers of electronic wet chemicals and specialty gases in China, competing with international suppliers predominantly from Europe, the US, and Japan. It holds a competitive position by achieving high product purity standards and securing supply contracts with major semiconductor fabs. Its technological advancements and product certifications have enabled it to break international monopolies in certain product categories, positioning it as a key player in China's semiconductor materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhongjuxin reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 15.16% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 10 million, though adjusted net profit excluding non-recurring items showed a slight loss. The company has steadily increased R&D investment, accounting for over 7% of revenue. Total assets reached around RMB 4 billion, with a stable equity base. The company is in a growth phase, expanding production capacity and market reach despite facing margin pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhongjuxin differentiates itself through its comprehensive product portfolio covering electronic wet chemicals, specialty gases, and precursor materials, enabling it to provide integrated solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. It emphasizes high product purity, stable quality, and compliance with stringent industry standards such as SEMI G5. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and close collaboration with leading semiconductor manufacturers allow it to tailor products to evolving process requirements, supporting domestic semiconductor industry self-sufficiency and reducing reliance on imports.
